lead_raw_text:
The structure of ZnAgTe₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with a unit cell containing eight atoms—Zn₂Ag₂Te₄—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Ag and Zn each adopt tetrahedral environments with four Te neighbors, while Te centers have five geometric neighbors (three Ag and two Zn). Corner-sharing is observed between Ag and Zn tetrahedra, and edge-sharing between Te polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
